items.text: nahi de sakta abhi
thoda waqt chahiye
kaam band ho gaya hai

items.context: Can you make the payment today?
items.text: abhi payment nahi kar sakta

items.context: Why haven't you paid the dues yet?
items.text: main hospital me hu

items.context: Do you understand the payment process?
items.text: mujhe samajh nahi aa raha
meri salary nahi aayi is mahine isliye paise nahi hain
meri tabiyat kharab hai aur doctor ne kaam se mana kiya hai
meri naukri chali gayi hai kal se main gareeb ho gaya hu
main abhi ghar par hi hoon aur parivar kaafi depend karta hai mujh par
main kal tak payment kar dunga jab tak thoda paisa ayega
mere brother ki tabiyat kharab hai isi liye main payment nahi kar pa raha
mera bank account blocked ho gaya hai is wajah se transfer nahi ho paya

items.context: Have you made your payment for this month?
items.text: main september ke month ka payment kar raha hoon abhi thoda delay hua hai
abhi tak koi income nahi hai isliye payment delay ho raha hai

items.context: Are you facing any issue sending the payment?
items.text: mujhe paise bhejne mein thodi dikkat ho rahi hai aaj kal

items.context: What is the reason for non payment?
items.text: meri job lost ho gayi hai isliye mein payment nahi kar pa raha

items.context: Can you request for payment extension?
items.text: main thoda samay chah raha hun payment ke liye financial problems ki wajah se
mera naam rohit sharma hai aur mera account number 1234 5678 9876 5432 hai main abhi unemployed hu is wajah se payment nahi kar paya
meri tabiyat kuch dino se bahut kharab chal rahi thi doctor ne rest lene ko kaha hai isliye paise jama karne mein problem ho rahi hai
kal se meri naukri band ho gayi hai aur mere paas koi aur income source nahi hai isliye main aaj payment karne mein asamarth hoon

items.context: Can you explain reason for delay in payment?
items.text: agent asked can you explain reason for delay in payment customer said mera bank account block hai abhi tak paisa transfer nahi kar paya

items.context: Is your family condition affecting your ability to pay?
items.text: agent asked is family condition affecting your ability to pay customer said haan meri maa ki tabiyat bahut kharab hai main sare kharche utha raha hu

items.context: When can you make the payment?
items.text: agent asked when can you make the payment customer said thoda jaldi paise mil jaayenge to agle hafte tak main payment kar dunga

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: collections
Intent: financial_hardship - explains they cannot pay right now because of job loss, illness or similar
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with numbers (account and phone numbers, OTPs, amounts, dates) written as numerals, with long numbers spaced in groups the way people say them

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
